title: Facade – Brackets & Fixings (PER)
activity: Cast-in channels, brackets, mullions, rainscreen fixings and pull-out tests
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Cast-in channels/inserts present, in position and not filled with concrete?
Control lines and datums marked before brackets go on?
Threaded rods (M24) positioned and level; grout applied under bearing plates?
Ask the fitter: Where should the fixing sit in the slot, and what torque are you using? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Brackets on setting-out within ±2 mm, matching the bracket code on the installation drawing?
Shims no thicker than the limit on the PER installation drawing; no stacked loose packers?
Bracket bolts tightened, sprayed and marked (blue/red line on the nut)?
Anchor pull-out tests done before panels are hung (test locations marked)?
Rainscreen brackets match the drawing code, on line and level?
Rainscreen panels aligned – max 2 mm step between neighbouring panels?
Anti-unhook screw fixed on every rainscreen panel?

notOk.t: Fixings bottomed out in slotted holes (must sit mid-slot for movement)
VCL not sealed at bracket penetrations
Brackets through waterproofing with no seal
Visible fixings not colour matched or proud

ask.q: What setting-out tolerance on the brackets?
ask.a: ±2 mm, matching the bracket code on the drawing.

ask.q: How do you know the bracket is the right type?
ask.a: Bracket code checked against the installation drawing.

ask.q: What's the max step between rainscreen panels?
